annotations.title: Export data or save a figure

description: Convert to an open format, or save a figure, as a new file read back and verified; the source is never touched. format: ome-tiff (images, default; pyramidal when the source is), ome-zarr (multiscale; plates as OME-NGFF HCS), mzml (mass spectra, default), csv (one table or one sweep of a trace, default for tables and traces), parquet or arrow (tables, traces with every sweep, spectra=true for MS points), nwb (electrophysiology), jcamp (NMR, IR/Raman, chromatograms), asm (plate readers), rdml (qPCR), nifti (volumes: CT, MRI). Figures: plot or preview = the arguments of that call, output .png, .jpg, .tiff, .svg or .pdf (scale, dpi for print); the picture comes back too. Sends progress with a progressToken.

Region.description: A rectangle of a plane, in the pixel coordinates of the resolution level it is read at.

x.description: Left edge (column of the first pixel).

y.description: Top edge (row of the first pixel).

centroid.description: mzML, Parquet, Arrow: write the instrument's centroid lists instead of profiles where a scan has both.

dpi.description: Figures: print resolution (e.g. 300), recorded in .png, .jpg and .tiff files; .svg and .pdf pages get the size the raster would print at.

file.description: Path to the file (not with plot or preview).

format.description: `ome-tiff` (one BigTIFF file; the default for images), `ome-zarr` (OME-NGFF 0.5 / Zarr v3 directory with a pyramid), `mzml` (indexed mzML 1.1.0; the default for mass spectra), `csv` (one table, or one sweep of a trace; the default for tables and traces), `parquet` or `arrow` (Arrow IPC file) for a table, a trace (all sweeps) or mass spectra (`spectra=true`), `nwb` (NWB 2.x; electrophysiology traces), `jcamp` (JCAMP-DX 5.01; NMR FIDs and spectra, other 1-D spectra and chromatograms), `asm` (Allotrope Simple Model plate-reader JSON), `rdml` (RDML 1.3; qPCR files), `fastq` (base calls: a Sanger read, its default, gives one file; an Illumina run folder gives a directory of gzip FASTQ, one file per lane and read, and rows `0-N` writes the first N+1 clusters of each lane), `nifti` (NIfTI-1 `.nii.gz`; one volume with voxel size and scanner orientation) or `mrc` (MRC2014; EM movies, stacks and diffraction images). Without it, the extension of `output` decides; it must not contradict `output`.

group_frames.description: MRC: sum every N time points into one section (dose fractions of a movie).

labels.description: CSV: add a second header line with column labels (FCS `$PnS`).

level.description: Images: export this source pyramid level as the full resolution (default 0).

output.description: Output path; defaults to the input with `.ome.tiff`, `.ome.zarr`, `.mzML`, `.csv`, `.asm.json`, `.rdml`, `.fastq`, `.parquet`, `.arrow`, `.nwb`, `.jdx`, `.nii.gz` or `.mrc`. Its extension sets the format when `format` is not given. Figures: .png, .jpg, .tiff, .svg or .pdf (default `<data file stem>.figure.png` or `.preview.png` next to the data).

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file or directory.

plot.description: Save a figure: the arguments of an openreadout_plot call. `output` names the file.

preview.description: Save a picture: the arguments of an openreadout_preview call (file, region, annotations, marks, dark, …); max_size up to 8192. Images are saved with a scale bar and no rulers (axes scale-bar; add title, caption) unless axes says otherwise.

region.description: Images: export only this rectangle `{x, y, width, height}` (pixels of `level`) of every plane, read tile by tile (cut a field out of a whole-slide image).

rows.description: CSV, Parquet, Arrow, NWB, JCAMP-DX: rows (samples of each sweep for traces) `A-B`, `A-` or `A`, zero-based and inclusive.

run.description: mzML, Parquet, Arrow: spectra run index (default 0).

scale.description: Figures: pixels per figure pixel in .png, .jpg and .tiff files (default 2, up to 8); image previews are read again at max_size × scale.

select.description: Images: plane selection strings such as `c=0`, `z=2-5`, `t=0,3`.

spectra.description: Parquet, Arrow: export the mass spectra of `run` (one row per point, plus a `<name>.scans.parquet` per-scan summary) instead of a table or trace.

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

sweep.description: CSV, Parquet, Arrow, NWB, JCAMP-DX: only this sweep (CSV default 0; the others: every sweep).

table.description: CSV, Parquet, Arrow: this table index (FCS data set, plate read, event or peak table).

trace.description: CSV, Parquet, Arrow, NWB, JCAMP-DX: this trace index (NWB default: every trace).

wells.description: OME-Zarr of a multi-well plate: only the fields of these wells (`C05`).

name: openreadout_export
